subtitle: Meeting details for the Network Graphics Working Group

tldr.problem: Working group members needed details for their next meeting on network graphics.
tldr.mechanism: The notice gives the dates, venue, attendance contact and some of the equipment available at the meeting site.
tldr.outcome: Attendees could contact the organizer to confirm plans and request special equipment in advance.

today: RFC 314 is a meeting announcement dated March 1972. It records the venue, equipment and arrangements planned for the Network Graphics Working Group.

sections.title: Meeting at Mitre
sections.content: The next Network Graphics Working Group meeting was scheduled for April 16 through 18 at The Mitre Corporation in McLean, Virginia. The notice asks people who plan to attend to tell Ira Cotton at Mitre as soon as possible.
sections.plainLanguage: The graphics working group planned to meet at Mitre from April 16 through 18. People who wanted to attend were asked to contact Ira Cotton.

sections.title: Facilities and Equipment
sections.content: The meeting would convene at 6 PM on Sunday evening and have facilities for slides and viewgraphs. Attendees were asked to request special equipment, such as a movie projector, in advance. Mitre had a TIP, teletypes, a Datapoint 3300, a 2741 and an Imlac on loan.
sections.plainLanguage: Mitre had several terminals and graphics equipment for the meeting. Attendees needed to ask ahead if they wanted special equipment.

sections.title: Travel and Attendance Arrangements
sections.content: A block of rooms had been reserved at the Tysons Corner Holiday Inn, about one mile from Mitre on Route 123. The notice says a single room cost $19 and asks attendees to reserve through Ira Cotton. It also says a banquet might be arranged if enough people were interested.
sections.plainLanguage: Rooms were held at a nearby hotel, and attendees could arrange one through Ira Cotton. A group dinner depended on the level of interest.
